items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover via Session Identity Flaw
items.summary: This critical incorrect authorization vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to switch customer sessions, hijack accounts, and access private data. It affects Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source versions through the July 2026 patches, and exploitation attempts have been observed in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This high-severity stored XSS vulnerability could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: This incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows low-privileged attackers to inject malicious scripts into form fields, potentially leading to session hijacking or unauthorized actions. The vulnerability has a changed scope, meaning the injected script can affect resources beyond the vulnerable component.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered this critical flaw in Magento's REST API, allowing unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files using a polyglot technique. While a fix was released in Magento 2.4.9, older supported versions remain vulnerable, and active exploitation attempts have been observed.
